Reading result for G2: no cause code covers a gate's trip back. The only back-related code, `loop_budget_spent`, covers a spent trip budget and not a completed trip back. I read the files only. I ran no commands and wrote nothing.

`ARTIFACT gap_finding: Triage G2 holds: self-improvement.spec.md (SIL-B11 line 39, SIL-B12 line 51, SIL-B4 line 45) has no trip-back cause; SIL-B11 only defines the three classes and the sides, and SIL-B12 names retry_burst, judge_blocked and blocked_without_check. improve/causes.py: the CAUSES table (26-103) has no BACK cause, though loop_budget_spent exists (34-35: fault, workflow, remedy "Strengthen the serving criterion upstream; trips back ran out"). derive() (120-221) produces it only from a `pause` record with pause_kind budget and reason loop_budget (177-178); it reads no `gate` record with verdict BACK (the only gate branch, 168-169, is ESCALATE with no verdict, giving judge_unparsed), so a trip back that was taken yields no cause (basis: read). run/gate.py:440-453 shows the gate's BACK branch: back_to not in back_targets gives pause escalation back_target_not_allowed (442-443); loops[target] >= loop_budget gives spent("loop_budget") (444-445); otherwise it counts the loop, clears from the target, routes BACK, and sets visits[target] = {visit+1, reason, from: unit, entered_from: "back:<unit>"} (446-453). Nothing there records units left, units reached or sessions run again as cause fields (basis: read); nodes.py:1950 writes a `budget` record counter loops:<target> used/limit. The code does count BACK elsewhere, as trouble in improve/review.py:130-134 (SRV-B24 `_trouble`), a BLOCKS set in improve/reliability.py:31, and improve/trials.py:193. loop_budget_spent is also ranked 1 in review.py:148 and listed in lenses.py:22 STABLE_FRICTION. Test: engine/tests/test_improve.py:32 pins only the pause-to-loop_budget_spent mapping (tested). A new cause would have to be added to CAUSES and derive(), with spec text in SIL-B11 or SIL-B12 and a fixture run for SIL-AC7 (line 196).`
